event_name: Hawkers 20 Tap Takeover - Only keg of X in NSW!
date_text: Thu, May 28th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, May 31st • 10:00 PM AEST
description: 20 Tap Takeover - on tap 'til they are drunk dry – normally our GAB’s weekend but lets make a weekend of it anyways! Also, Laurence's last day with Hawkers, come and have a beer with him - he will be full of banter and laughs as usual. We’ve teamed up with Hawkers to bring you a mix of super-limited releases and some of their legendary favourites, all pouring fresh across our taps. Taplist:- - Double West Coast IPA - Pilsner - Original Pale Ale - Pico De Cryo - Four Seasons Autumn - WBA White Stout - Seeing Red Feeling Good - WBA Black Barleywine - Imperial Stout 2026 - Four Seasons Summer - X 10th birthday beer CHAMPION - Guava Train - Hazy Pale - Stout - Lager - West Coast IPA - Into The Forest - IPA - Hazy IPA - Pale Ale
